evals.prompt: File a bug in acme/billing-api: invoice PDFs render the total in the wrong currency when the customer account is set to EUR. Steps: create an EUR customer, add a 10 EUR line, download the invoice; the PDF shows $10.
evals.expected_output: One Bug issue created in acme/billing-api with the Bug Report body layout and its URL reported.
expectations: The agent runs gh api repos/acme/billing-api/issues -X POST or gh issue create with --repo acme/billing-api
The issue body contains the sections Description, Steps to Reproduce, Expected Behavior and Actual Behavior
The agent sets the issue type Bug through -f type=Bug or the updateIssue GraphQL mutation rather than only adding a bug label
The response ends with the created issue URL

evals.prompt: Create a feature request for dark mode in the web-app repo.
evals.expected_output: The agent asks which owner/repository to use before creating anything, or confirms the repository detected from the current directory.
expectations: The agent confirms the repository (owner and name) before running a write command
No gh issue create or gh api POST call runs before the repository is confirmed
Once confirmed, the issue body follows the Feature Request template with Summary, Motivation, Proposed Solution and Acceptance Criteria

evals.prompt: Issue #42 in acme/web-app is an epic. Make #57 a sub-issue of it and mark #57 as blocked by #51.
evals.expected_output: Issue 57 linked as a sub-issue of 42 through the addSubIssue GraphQL mutation and a blocked_by dependency on 51 added through the REST dependencies endpoint.
expectations: The agent fetches node IDs with gh issue view <n> --json id and calls gh api graphql with the addSubIssue mutation
The agent does not attempt gh issue create --parent or gh issue edit --add-sub-issue
The agent calls gh api repos/acme/web-app/issues/57/dependencies/blocked_by -X POST with -F issue_id set to the numeric id of issue 51
The response reports both links as done or reports the exact command that failed
